description: This PHP class defines the entity 'BuzzLikeOnComment' for Doctrine ORM. It models a 'like' on a comment within a social or buzz feature of the OrangeHRM system, including properties such as the comment, employee who liked it, and timestamp.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnComment
classes.description: An ORM entity representing a 'like' given by an employee on a comment within the Buzz feature.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the like record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the like record.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Associates a BuzzComment entity with this like.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee who liked the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this like.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the like was made, in UTC.

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of when the like was made to the current UTC time.
